features.quote: The loop runs for at most `max_steps` tool-call rounds (default 30).
features.justification_quote: Step count maps directly to LLM calls, the dominant cost.

features.quote: If the same fingerprint repeats `loop_repeat_limit` (default 3) times *consecutively*, the loop terminates
features.justification_quote: the most blatant form of looping... This is the highest-signal, lowest-cost loop signal.
